Procedures.title: العملية المناسبة لجسمك، لا خطة واحدة للجميع.
Procedures.aside: يبدأ كل مريض بتقييم شامل، ثم نختار معًا الخيار الذي يناسب صحتك وأهدافك وحياتك.

sleeve.name: تكميم المعدة
sleeve.desc: [AR] Removes the larger part of the stomach, reducing how much you can eat and the hunger hormone it produces.
sleeve.descShort: [AR] Removes the larger part of the stomach to reduce appetite and intake.
sleeve.meta: [AR] Stay [X days] · Back to work [X weeks]

bypass.name: تحويل مسار المعدة
bypass.desc: [AR] Full or partial (mini) bypass: a small stomach pouch is connected directly to the small intestine.
bypass.descShort: [AR] Full or partial bypass — a small pouch joined to the small intestine.
bypass.meta: [AR] Stay [X days] · Back to work [X weeks]

plication.name: طي المعدة
plication.desc: [AR] The stomach is folded inward and stitched to reduce its volume — no part of the stomach is removed.
plication.descShort: [AR] The stomach is folded and stitched — nothing is removed.
plication.meta: [AR] Stay [X days] · Back to work [X weeks]

balloon.name: بالون المعدة
balloon.desc: [AR] A soft balloon placed by endoscopy for a set period — a first step for patients who need moderate weight loss.
balloon.descShort: [AR] Placed by endoscopy for a set period, no surgery.

Procedures.notSure: لست متأكدًا أيها يناسبك؟ هذا تحديدًا ما وُجدت الاستشارة الأولى من أجله.

bariatricMedicine.name: طب السمنة
bariatricMedicine.desc: [AR] Medical preparation before surgery and monitoring after it.

clinicalNutrition.name: التغذية العلاجية

Doctor.name: د. محسن كرم
Doctor.role: استشاري الجراحة العامة وجراحات المناظير والسمنة
Doctor.bio: [AR] [Draft for Dr. Karam's approval] I graduated in medicine from Alexandria University, completed my Master of Surgery there and became a Fellow of the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland in 1999. For 25 years I practised at Hamad Medical Corporation in Qatar, joining its bariatric and metabolic surgery team in 2013 and working as a consultant from 2018, while teaching residents and fellows and publishing research on sleeve gastrectomy outcomes and safety. At Delta Bariatric Center I bring that experience home to Alexandria, with a team that stays with every patient long after surgery.
Doctor.bioShort: [AR] [Draft for approval] Alexandria graduate and FRCSI, with 25 years at Hamad Medical Corporation in Qatar and bariatric surgery since 2013. Now practising in Alexandria with a team that stays with every patient.

messages.low: [AR] Surgery is usually not indicated at this BMI. We are happy to talk through other options with you.
messages.mid: [AR] You may qualify for the gastric balloon or, with related health conditions, for surgery.
messages.high: [AR] You may be a candidate for bariatric surgery. A consultation will confirm the right option.

Bmi.note: مؤشر تقريبي فقط، وليس تشخيصًا طبيًا.
Bmi.scaleLabel: مقياس مؤشر كتلة الجسم من 18 إلى 50

candidate.a: [AR] Generally, adults with a BMI of 35 or more, or 30 or more with conditions such as type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure or sleep apnea, may qualify. Dr. Karam will confirm after a full assessment.

laparoscopic.a: [AR] Yes. Most procedures are performed through small keyhole incisions, which means less pain, smaller scars and a faster recovery.

stay.a: [AR] Most patients stay one to three nights depending on the procedure. The gastric balloon is placed and you go home the same day.

work.a: [AR] Many patients return to desk work within two to three weeks. Physically demanding work may need longer.

after.a: [AR] You follow a staged diet with our nutrition team and attend regular follow-up visits so we can track your progress.
